label: Pressure Reactivity Index 0
definition: A calculated index representing the relative number of minutes with negative pressure reactivity, indicating impaired cerebral autoregulation.

label: Cerebral Perfusion Pressure Variation
definition: Changes in cerebral perfusion pressure following therapeutic intervention, which may vary in direction and magnitude.

label: Cerebral Perfusion Pressure Control
definition: A therapeutic target and monitoring parameter measuring mean cerebral perfusion pressure in mmHg.

label: Pressure Reactivity Index Reduction
definition: A change in pressure reactivity index values following therapeutic intervention, reflecting potential improvement in cerebrovascular autoregulation.

label: Demographic Parameters
definition: Patient characteristics including age and gender used as inputs to the predictive neural network model.

label: Secondary Ischemic Insults
definition: Preventable complications of traumatic brain injury caused by inadequate cerebral perfusion or elevated intracranial pressure.

label: Demographic Indicators
definition: Patient characteristics used as input variables for predictive models of hypotensive events.

label: Hypotensive Events
definition: Abnormally low blood pressure episodes that occur in clinical settings, a recognized secondary insult in neurointensive care.

label: Intracranial Pressure Insult
definition: An episode of elevated intracranial pressure defined by intensity (pressure threshold in mmHg) and duration (time in minutes), used to assess burden of pressure derangements.

label: Patient Instability
definition: A state of physiological deterioration in which early warning of impending hypotensive events can be provided.

label: Head Elevation
definition: A nursing intervention positioning patients with their head elevated at 30 degrees to manage intracranial pressure.

label: Therapy Intensity Level (TIL)
definition: A quantitative measure of the intensity and complexity of interventions applied for intracranial pressure management.

label: Pupil Abnormality
definition: A clinical sign defined as the presence of two unreactive pupils or anisocoria, indicating neurological injury.

label: Intracranial Pressure Reduction
definition: The decrease in intracranial pressure achieved through therapeutic intervention, measured as absolute or percentage change.

label: Heart Rate Variability
definition: Variation in the time interval between heartbeats, used as a predictor of hypotension in intensive care patients.

label: Intracranial Hypertension Index 20
definition: A calculated index representing the percentage of monitoring time with intracranial pressure exceeding 20 mmHg.

label: Patient Assent
definition: Informed agreement obtained from patients or their relatives/next of kin for participation in clinical research.

label: Glasgow Outcome Score (GOS)
definition: A clinical outcome measure assessing patient recovery, with worse outcomes associated with ICP insults above specific thresholds and durations.

label: Therapy Intensity Level Scale (TIL)
definition: A scale used to assess the intensity of ICP-lowering strategies applied until immediately before decompressive craniectomy.

label: Therapy Intensity Level Basic (til Basic)
definition: A basic scoring system for quantifying the intensity of ICP-directed treatments, with scores 0-4.

label: Time Between Arrival and Decompressive Craniectomy
definition: The interval in hours from emergency department arrival to surgical intervention, measured as a clinical management parameter.

label: Intracranial Hypertension Index 25
definition: A calculated index representing the percentage of monitoring time with intracranial pressure exceeding 25 mmHg.

label: Clinical Alarm
definition: An alert generated when a secondary insult occurs to enable immediate treatment initiation.

label: Clinical Monitoring
definition: Continuous or periodic measurement and observation of physiological parameters in patient care.

label: Arterial Pressure Line
definition: An invasive monitoring device for continuous blood pressure measurement, susceptible to artifact from blood sampling and line damping.

label: Intensive Care Unit
definition: A hospital unit providing critical care to severely ill or injured patients, where prediction information was not available to clinical teams during the study.

label: Patient Outcome
definition: Clinical results and endpoints measured to assess the effectiveness of interventions guided by predictive warnings.

label: Nursing Procedure
definition: Clinical care activities performed by nursing staff as part of ICU management.

label: Bedside Monitor
definition: A device used to continuously record physiological measurements in the ICU.

label: Physiological Monitoring Data
definition: Continuously recorded measurements of physiological parameters including ICP, CPP, and PRx collected through patient data management systems.

label: Clinical Study Design
definition: The overall structure and methodology of prospective clinical research evaluating predictive model performance.

label: Outcome Data
definition: Clinical information documenting patient recovery and functional status at specified time points post-injury.

label: Brain Injury
definition: A clinical condition in patients for which the HYPO-NET technology was originally developed and tested.

label: Clinical Setting
definition: A live hospital or intensive care environment where the predictive model is evaluated with real patient data.

label: Patient Representatives
definition: Family members or designated advocates who provide consent and input on behalf of traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Continuous Monitoring Data
definition: High-resolution physiological measurements recorded minute-by-minute from patient monitors in the ICU.

label: Secondary Brain Injury
definition: Secondary insults of raised intracranial pressure occurring in traumatic brain injury patients, characterized by intensity and duration thresholds that vary by age and autoregulatory status.

label: Intracranial Insult
definition: A secondary insult resulting from high intracranial pressure caused by mass lesions and ischaemic mechanisms resulting in brain swelling.

label: Bifrontal Craniectomy
definition: A surgical variant of decompressive craniectomy involving bilateral frontal skull removal for intracranial pressure reduction.

label: Cerebral Hypoperfusion Index 60
definition: A calculated index representing the percentage of monitoring time with cerebral perfusion pressure below 60 mmHg.

label: Clinical Examination
definition: Bedside neurological assessment used alongside monitoring data to estimate risk for secondary brain injury in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Clinical Study
definition: A prospective study collecting physiological data to evaluate predictive model performance in a live clinical setting.

label: Arterial Oxygen Saturation
definition: Core BrainIT parameter. Arterial oxygen saturation by Pulse Oximetry.

label: Post-operative Intracranial Pressure
definition: The intracranial pressure measurement recorded in the period following surgical intervention.

label: Pulse Pressure
definition: The difference between systolic and diastolic blood pressure, used as a quality check for blood pressure measurement validity.

label: Outcome Predictor
definition: A clinical variable or parameter used to forecast patient recovery or mortality, with ICP burden and autoregulatory status serving as independent predictors.

label: Neurological Outcome
definition: Patient recovery or clinical result following traumatic brain injury management, influenced by intracranial pressure and cerebral perfusion pressure control.

label: Intensive Care Unit (ICU) Stay
definition: The period of time a patient spends in the intensive care unit during which monitoring and treatment occur.

label: Pre-operative Intracranial Pressure
definition: The intracranial pressure measurement recorded in the period immediately before surgical intervention.

label: Surgical Group
definition: Patients in the RESCUEicp trial who underwent surgical intervention (decompressive craniectomy).

label: Secondary Ischemic Damage
definition: Brain tissue damage resulting from reduced cerebral blood flow following primary TBI, prevented by ICP control.

label: Intracranial Hypoperfusion Index 60
definition: A monitoring parameter measuring the percentage of time cerebral perfusion pressure is below 60 mmHg.

label: Time Window
definition: A temporal interval over which physiological features are calculated, including 30-15 minutes and 15 minutes to prediction time.

label: Intracranial Hypoperfusion Index Reduction
definition: A trend toward reduction in the percentage of monitoring time with cerebral perfusion pressure below 60 mmHg following intervention.

label: Routine Blood Sample
definition: Laboratory specimens collected as part of standard clinical care to assess patient status.

label: Haemodialysis
definition: Renal replacement therapy in which artificial neural networks are used to predict hypotension risk and other clinical outcomes.

label: Minute-by-minute Data
definition: Physiological measurements recorded continuously and aggregated to one-minute intervals for analysis of ICP and MAP trends.

label: Arterial Blood Pressure Waveform
definition: The continuous pressure wave recorded from arterial blood pressure monitoring, used for prediction of hypotensive episodes.

label: Posttraumatic Intracranial Hypertension
definition: Elevated intracranial pressure occurring as a secondary consequence of traumatic brain injury.

label: Icp-directed Therapy
definition: Treatment interventions specifically aimed at reducing or managing elevated intracranial pressure in traumatic brain injury.

label: Unfavourable Neurological Outcome
definition: A clinical outcome measure defined as death, vegetative state, or severe disability (GOS 1-3).

label: Blood Pressure Transducer
definition: A monitoring device placed at atrium level to measure arterial blood pressure for CPP calculation.

label: Extracranial Injuries
definition: Traumatic injury occurring outside the cranium, often coexisting with traumatic brain injury.

label: Haemodialysis Treatment
definition: A renal replacement therapy during which hypotensive events can occur and be predicted by neural network models.

label: Acute Hypotensive Episode
definition: A sudden, clinically significant drop in blood pressure occurring in intensive care patients that requires prediction and intervention.

label: Physiological Data
definition: Measurements of physiological parameters including intracranial pressure, cerebral perfusion pressure, and autoregulation indices.

label: Neuro-icu
definition: A neurointensive care unit providing specialized monitoring and management of severe TBI and other neurocritical conditions.

label: Cumulative Dose of ICP Insults
definition: The aggregate measure of ICP insult burden, combining intensity and duration parameters, assessed for independent association with outcome.

label: ICP Intensity Threshold
definition: A specific pressure value (in mmHg) used to define and classify ICP insult episodes.

label: Severe Traumatic Brain Injury
definition: A severe head injury resulting in significant brain trauma, the primary clinical condition studied in this analysis.

label: Septic Shock
definition: A life-threatening condition of severe infection with hypotension requiring urgent antimicrobial therapy.

label: Median Pressure Reactivity Index 0
definition: A derived parameter representing the median percentage of monitoring time with pressure reactivity index exceeding 0, indicating impaired cerebrovascular autoregulation.

label: Systolic Arterial Blood Pressure
definition: The peak arterial blood pressure during ventricular contraction, measured as a mean value and slope feature for predictive modeling.

label: Mechanical Ventilation
definition: Artificial respiratory support provided to critically ill patients, a major contributor to intensive care unit costs.

label: Standard Medical Treatment
definition: Conservative pharmacological and physiological management of traumatic brain injury without surgical decompression.

label: Mean Feature
definition: A statistical feature calculated as the average value of a physiological variable over a time window.

label: Input Feature
definition: A variable calculated from physiological measurements and used as input to the neural network model for prediction.

label: Clinical Effectiveness
definition: The demonstrated ability of a technology to improve patient outcomes and clinical management in real-world practice.

label: Hypoperfusion
definition: Inadequate blood flow to brain tissue, a consequence of uncontrolled intracranial hypertension.

label: Blood Pressure Data
definition: Recorded measurements of systolic, diastolic, and mean arterial pressure used for hypotension event detection and analysis.

label: Medical Device Alarms
definition: Auditory and visual alerts from multiple medical devices surrounding the patient in intensive care units.

label: Critical Care
definition: A technology-intensive medical domain focused on managing critically ill patients, where machine learning can harness large physiological datasets.

label: Hypocapnia
definition: Reduction of carbon dioxide levels in blood, used as a second-tier strategy for ICP control.

label: Non-Invasive Blood Pressure
definition: Non-invasive blood pressure. Optional BrainIT parameter.

label: Neurosurgeon
definition: A surgeon specializing in surgical treatment of neurological conditions, including decompressive craniectomy for traumatic brain injury.

label: Baseline Risk Factor
definition: A clinical or demographic variable (age, gender, GCS, pupil reactivity) recorded at admission to predict outcome in severe TBI.

label: Neuro-intensivist
definition: A physician specializing in intensive care management of neurological conditions including traumatic brain injury.

label: System Robustness
definition: The reliability and consistency of the predictive system's performance across different clinical environments and patient populations.

label: Cranioplasty
definition: A surgical procedure to repair or reconstruct the skull, performed after decompressive craniectomy.

label: Median Intracranial Hypertension Index 20
definition: A derived parameter representing the median percentage of monitoring time with intracranial pressure exceeding 20 mmHg.

label: Moderate Traumatic Brain Injury
definition: A moderate form of traumatic brain injury with measurable neurological impairment requiring specialized care.

label: Clinical Pragmatism
definition: The practical clinical requirement to balance system performance metrics with acceptable false-positive rates for operational feasibility.

label: Third-tier Intervention
definition: Advanced medical therapy for refractory intracranial hypertension, including barbiturate administration.

label: Median Intracranial Hypertension Index 25
definition: A derived parameter representing the median percentage of monitoring time with intracranial pressure exceeding 25 mmHg.

label: Traumatic Intracranial Hypertension
definition: Elevated pressure inside the cranium resulting from traumatic brain injury, a critical secondary insult requiring intervention.

label: Adult Traumatic Brain Injury Patient
definition: A patient aged 16 years or older admitted to neuro-ICU with severe TBI requiring continuous ICP monitoring.

label: Icp-lowering Treatment
definition: Medical or surgical interventions employed to reduce intracranial pressure in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Second-tier Intervention
definition: Intermediate management strategies for ICP control including deepened sedation, CSF drainage, moderate hypocapnia, and hyperosmolar molecules.

label: Combination Therapy Approach
definition: The simultaneous or sequential use of multiple therapeutic interventions to manage elevated intracranial pressure.

label: Primary Brain Damage
definition: The initial injury to the brain caused by traumatic impact.

label: Unacceptably High Intracranial Pressure
definition: A clinical threshold of elevated intracranial pressure that triggers escalation to surgical intervention.

label: CPP Safety Limits
definition: Defined upper and lower boundaries for cerebral perfusion pressure to prevent secondary insults in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Pressure Area Care
definition: Nursing intervention to prevent pressure ulcers, a procedure that can cause movement artifact in monitoring systems.

label: Head Trauma
definition: Traumatic injury to the head, a critical condition requiring intensive monitoring and management in the ICU.

label: First-tier Intervention
definition: Initial management strategies for ICP control including head elevation, neuromuscular paralysis, analgesia, sedation, normocapnia, and normothermia.

label: Routine Patient Hygiene
definition: Standard nursing care procedures that can cause patient movement and artifact in blood pressure monitoring.

label: Injury Mechanism
definition: The cause or type of trauma resulting in traumatic brain injury.

label: Malignant Intracranial Pressure Course
definition: A pattern of intracranial pressure elevation that follows a progressive or uncontrollable trajectory despite medical interventions.

label: Neuro-intensive Care Center
definition: A specialized hospital facility providing intensive care to patients with neurological injuries, participating in the BrainIT multi-center study.

label: Multimodality Monitoring
definition: Comprehensive clinical assessment combining multiple monitoring modalities including intracranial pressure, cerebral perfusion pressure, and autoregulation assessment.

label: ICP Duration Threshold
definition: A specific time duration used to define and classify ICP insult episodes.

label: Neurointensive Care
definition: Specialized intensive care management focused on neurological conditions including severe traumatic brain injury.

label: Disability
definition: Functional impairment or limitation in activities of daily living following TBI.

label: Bilateral Fixed and Dilated Pupils
definition: A severe neurological sign indicating brainstem injury, used as an exclusion criterion.

label: Standard Deviation Feature
definition: A statistical feature representing the variability of a physiological variable over a time window.

label: Stich Trial
definition: A randomized controlled trial evaluating surgical evacuation versus conservative management of intracerebral hemorrhage.

label: Vital Physiological System
definition: Core bodily functions that are stabilized and monitored in emergency trauma care.

label: Prediction Time
definition: The temporal reference point at which the model generates a prediction of hypotensive event onset.

label: Vegetative State Outcome
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale category indicating severe neurological disability with preserved sleep-wake cycles but no awareness.

label: Traumatic Brain Injury
definition: A severe neurological condition characterized by secondary brain injury insults and impaired autoregulation, requiring minute-by-minute monitoring of intracranial pressure and cerebral perfusion pressure.

label: Six Hours Pre-intervention Monitoring
definition: A standardized time window of six hours immediately preceding surgical intervention used for physiological data collection and comparison.

label: Pressure-time Dose
definition: The cumulative time/pressure dose of elevated intracranial pressure per patient, defined as the percentage of time in the red zone or area under the ICP curve above 20 mmHg.

label: Median Mean Intracranial Pressure
definition: The median value of mean intracranial pressure calculated over a specified monitoring period.

label: Paediatric Traumatic Brain Injury Patient
definition: A child aged 2 to 16 years admitted to neuro-ICU with severe TBI, demonstrating lower ICP thresholds for worse outcome compared to adults.

label: Clinical Environment
definition: The operational ICU setting where predictive models must function reliably with real-time clinical data.

label: Monitoring Time in Red Zone
definition: The percentage of monitoring time during which ICP exceeded a critical threshold, a significant predictor of unfavourable outcome and mortality.

label: Upper Good Recovery
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating excellent functional recovery with minimal or no residual neurological deficits.

label: Lower Good Recovery
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating good functional recovery with minor residual symptoms.

label: Trip Trial
definition: A clinical trial that fostered renewed interest in defining secondary insults and therapeutic thresholds for ICP management in severe TBI.

label: Vegetative State
definition: A severe outcome state characterized by wakefulness without awareness, part of Glasgow Outcome Scale classification.

label: Guideline Adherence
definition: The degree to which medical staff follow expected clinical response protocols in reaction to system warnings.

label: Head Injury
definition: A traumatic injury to the head, for which reducing the burden of hypotension is clinically important.

label: Cerebrovascular Autoregulation
definition: The brain's ability to maintain constant blood flow despite changes in perfusion pressure, with status affecting ICP tolerance and transition curves in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Second-tier Therapies
definition: Intermediate-intensity interventions for ICP management in traumatic brain injury, applied when first-line measures are insufficient.

label: Warning Time
definition: The advance notice period provided by the predictive system before a hypotensive event occurs, enabling clinical intervention.

label: Hybrid Monte-carlo Technique
definition: A computational method used in Bayesian analysis to estimate error bars and mitigate over-fitting in neural network predictions.

label: Passive Autoregulation
definition: Loss of cerebrovascular autoregulation in which cerebral blood flow becomes pressure-dependent, associated with shorter ICP duration thresholds before worse outcome.

label: Oxygen Saturation (SaO2)
definition: Arterial oxygen saturation measured by pulse oximetry, tested as a potential input to predictive models.

label: Phase Ii Study
definition: A repeat clinical study using modified methodology to further validate the predictive model performance in live clinical settings.

label: Insult Duration
definition: The length of time an ICP insult episode persists, measured in minutes.

label: ICP Insult
definition: An episode of elevated intracranial pressure above a specified intensity threshold sustained for a measurable duration, quantified in the analysis of pressure-time burden.

label: General Anesthesia
definition: Pharmacological induction of unconsciousness and analgesia, a procedure associated with risk of hypotension.

label: Interquartile range
definition: A statistical measure of the spread of CPP values around the median for each patient and centre.

label: Big Data
definition: The large-scale collection and analysis of vast amounts of patient data in healthcare, with potential to transform clinical practice.

label: Computed Tomography
definition: A medical imaging modality used in the assessment and monitoring of head-injured patients.

label: Intensity Threshold
definition: A critical ICP value (in mmHg) above which elevated pressure is considered a secondary insult, with thresholds of 15 and 20 mmHg used in this analysis.

label: Active Autoregulation
definition: Functional cerebrovascular autoregulation in which the brain maintains stable perfusion despite pressure changes, associated with longer ICP duration thresholds before worse outcome.

label: Ischaemic Mechanism
definition: A pathophysiological process involving reduced blood flow and oxygen delivery that contributes to brain swelling and secondary insults.

label: Active ICP Insult
definition: An ICP insult episode classified as 'active' when its average LAx is negative or zero, indicating intact autoregulation.

label: Non-evacuated Mass Lesion (NEML)
definition: An intracranial mass lesion (such as contusion or hematoma) that is managed conservatively without surgical evacuation.

label: Supratentorial Lobar Intracerebral Haematoma
definition: Bleeding in the lobar regions above the tentorium cerebelli, a specific type of intracranial hemorrhage.

label: Neuro-critical Care
definition: Intensive care management of patients with neurological conditions such as traumatic brain injury.

label: Anonymized Data
definition: Patient clinical information collected without identifying information to protect privacy.

label: Phase 2 Study
definition: A repeat prospective clinical study recruiting 49 patients to validate the predictive model results from Phase 1.

label: Motor Impairment
definition: Reduced motor function assessed using the Glasgow Motor Score, indicating neurological injury severity.

label: Selfotel Trial
definition: A randomised controlled trial providing post hoc analysis data on the effects of high-dose vasopressor administration on CPP and outcomes in TBI.

label: Phase I Study
definition: An initial clinical study of 30 patients to validate data acquisition and prediction software in a live clinical environment.

label: Ischaemia
definition: Inadequate blood flow to brain tissue, a secondary insult associated with low cerebral perfusion pressure.

label: Pragmatic Clinical Setting
definition: Real-world clinical practice environment where multiple interventions are applied flexibly based on individual patient needs.

label: Severe Disability
definition: A functional outcome category indicating significant impairment in activities of daily living, subdivided into lower and upper categories.

label: Lower Severe Disability
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating severe functional impairment with some level of consciousness and limited independence.

label: CPP Threshold
definition: A target range for cerebral perfusion pressure used to guide clinical management in TBI, updated from above 70 mmHg to 50-70 mmHg in 2007.

label: Hanfelt Two-stage Design
definition: A clinical trial design used to minimize patient recruitment in Phase II studies, consisting of an initial collection phase followed by a subsequent phase.

label: Pragmatic Clinical Decision-making
definition: Real-world clinical practice involving tailored treatment decisions and combination therapies based on individual patient needs rather than strict protocol adherence.

label: Lower Moderate Disability
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating moderate functional impairment with capacity for independent living with support.

label: Episodic Data
definition: Clinical information recorded during patient stay including treatments given, laboratory results, and nursing procedures.

label: Seven Days Post-intervention Monitoring
definition: A standardized follow-up period of seven days following surgical intervention for assessment of physiological parameters.

label: Median Intracranial Hypoperfusion Index 60
definition: A derived parameter representing the median percentage of monitoring time with cerebral perfusion pressure below 60 mmHg.

label: Vital Signs Monitoring
definition: Continuous or frequent measurement of physiological parameters such as blood pressure and heart rate in critically ill patients.

label: Follow-up Period
definition: The time interval after TBI treatment during which patient outcomes are assessed and measured.

label: Intracerebral Haematoma
definition: Bleeding within the brain tissue resulting from traumatic or spontaneous causes.

label: Mortality
definition: Patient death occurring during hospitalization, a clinical outcome measure affected by treatment delays in sepsis management.

label: ICP Threshold
definition: A critical pressure level (e.g., 20 mmHg) above which elevated intracranial pressure is considered pathological and requires therapeutic intervention.

label: Phase 1 Study
definition: The first prospective clinical study collecting data on 30 patients to evaluate HYPO-NET model performance.

label: Everyday Clinical Practice
definition: Real-world clinical management reflecting routine decision-making and treatment patterns in neurointensive care settings.

label: Electronic Health Records
definition: Digital patient data systems that capture and store clinical information combined with real-time physiological monitoring data.

label: Good Recovery
definition: A favorable functional outcome category indicating return to normal or near-normal function, subdivided into lower and upper categories.

label: Admission Time to Icu
definition: The timestamp of patient admission to intensive care, tested as a potential temporal input to predictive models.

label: Robertson Trial
definition: A randomised controlled trial demonstrating the non-beneficial effect of maintaining CPP above 70 mmHg through high-dose vasopressor administration.

label: Severely Disabled
definition: A state of severe functional impairment representing unfavourable outcome in TBI patients (GOS 1-3).

label: Continued Sedation
definition: A first-tier management strategy maintaining ongoing sedation in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: TBI Guidelines
definition: Clinical practice guidelines for the management of severe traumatic brain injury, including recommendations for cerebral perfusion pressure targets.

label: Early Warning System
definition: A monitoring system that sends out alarms before a secondary insult occurs to allow preventive clinical intervention.

label: Model Performance
definition: The accuracy and reliability of the predictive model as measured by AUC, sensitivity, and specificity metrics.

label: Admission Data
definition: Clinical information recorded at the time of patient admission to neurosurgical care, collected as part of the BrainIT dataset.

label: Invalid Events
definition: Hypotension events that run to completion but contain missing time blocks of data.

label: Phase 1 Pilot Study
definition: An initial prospective pilot study (n=30) conducted with the prediction system running live in the clinical environment.

label: Deepening of Sedation
definition: A second-tier intervention involving increased depth of sedation to manage elevated intracranial pressure.

label: Duration Threshold
definition: The minimum time (in minutes) that ICP must remain elevated above a given intensity threshold before it is associated with worse neurological outcome.

label: 6-month Outcome
definition: The neurological status or survival status of patients assessed at 6 months post-injury.

label: End-Tidal Carbon Dioxide
definition: A respiratory monitoring parameter reflecting ventilation adequacy, tested as a potential input to predictive models.

label: Passive ICP Insult
definition: An ICP insult episode classified as 'passive' when its average LAx is positive, indicating impaired autoregulation.

label: Unmet Clinical Need
definition: Areas of clinical practice where current technology or management approaches are insufficient, requiring innovation and collaboration.

label: Gender
definition: A baseline demographic characteristic of patients included in data collection.

label: Abandoned Events
definition: Hypotension events in the active state where subsequent blood pressure readings contain missing or invalid measurements.

label: Insult Grading (EUSIG) Classification
definition: A classification system used to analyze and categorize hypotension events in patient datasets.

label: Descriptive Switching Linear Dynamical System Model
definition: A machine learning approach developed to automatically detect arterial pressure artifact from line interruption and damping events.

label: Multidisciplinary Consensus
definition: Agreement among multiple clinical specialists (neurosurgeon and neuro-intensivist) regarding treatment decisions in traumatic brain injury.

label: Diffuse Brain Injury
definition: A traumatic brain injury pattern characterized by widespread damage without focal mass lesions, classified by Marshall score.

label: Upper Moderate Disability
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating moderate disability with greater functional independence than lower moderate disability.

label: Impact Model
definition: A prognostic model incorporating core variables (age, admission motor GCS, pupils) used in outcome analysis.

label: User Interface
definition: The display and presentation system for delivering critical warnings and predictions to intensive care medical staff.

label: Slope Feature
definition: A statistical feature representing the rate of change of a physiological variable over a time window.

label: Third-tier Therapies
definition: Advanced interventions for refractory intracranial hypertension in severe traumatic brain injury, including decompressive craniectomy.

label: Non-rct Group
definition: A prospective cohort of TBI patients from Brain-IT database and UHL cohort who underwent decompressive craniectomy, not part of a randomized controlled trial.

label: Multi-center Study
definition: A clinical research design involving multiple intensive care units testing the HYPO-NET system in a real-time environment.

label: Precision Recall Plot
definition: A graphical representation of model performance showing precision versus recall for evaluating predictive accuracy.

label: Insult Intensity
definition: The magnitude or severity of an ICP insult episode, measured in mmHg above a specified threshold.

label: Hyperosmolar Molecule Administration
definition: A second-tier medical intervention using osmotically active substances to reduce intracranial pressure by drawing fluid from the brain parenchyma.

label: Hyperosmolar Molecules
definition: Osmotic agents administered as second-tier therapy to reduce intracranial pressure.

label: Moving Pearson Correlation Coefficient
definition: A statistical measure used to calculate pressure reactivity index as the correlation between changes in mean arterial pressure and intracranial pressure.

label: Upper Severe Disability
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating severe disability with greater functional capacity than lower severe disability.

label: Moderate Disability
definition: A functional outcome category indicating moderate impairment in daily activities, subdivided into lower and upper categories.

label: Pearson Correlation Coefficient
definition: A statistical measure of linear dependency between ICP insult frequency and outcome category, used to identify which insult types associate with worse outcomes.

label: Age
definition: Patient demographic characteristic measured in years, used for cohort characterization and comparison.

label: Nonlinear Regression
definition: A statistical modeling technique used by artificial neural networks to capture complex relationships in physiological data.

label: Crash Score
definition: A prognostic model predicting unfavorable outcomes in TBI patients based on clinical and imaging variables.
